description: Views of the card and clicks through to the site: thirty days on the free tier; ninety days and the shelf beside it on premium. With what Google showed of the card last month (impressions, clicks, top queries) and its neighbours on the shelf. Needs a signed-in inite.ai account: a guest call answers 401 and starts the OAuth flow.
